diagrams.title: The Pay-Per-Lead Arbitrage Loop
diagrams.subtitle: One niche, one brand, one ad account, leads resold to buyers who already pay for them

stages.label: Pick One Niche Worth $100+ Per Lead
stages.detail: One niche, one brand, one ad account. My First Million warns operators below $100 per lead struggle to copy the blueprint.

stages.label: Generate Leads at $18 to $50
stages.detail: Kelly Joseph's math at a $25 CPL turns $1k of spend into 40 leads. Media buying is the key skill in an arbitrage model (Billy Robinson).

stages.label: Price Backward from 2x to 3x Buyer ROAS
stages.detail: Resell at 1.5x to 3x cost. Hunter Ceroy sets every price so the client clears a 2x to 3x return and reorders. Joseph sells the 40 leads at $60 each for $2,400 revenue and $1,400 profit.

stages.label: Deliver with Speed-to-Lead Automation
stages.detail: AI SMS agents, three automated texts and two-minute call rules. Robinson demos the bot live and reports closing one in three against a $3,750 minimum order.

stages.label: Post Sold Leads Back Server-Side
stages.detail: Conversions API through Stape.io, which Joseph calls the moat. New buyers prepay, and delivery pauses when payment is 7 days late.

diagrams.caption: Operators who left retainers report monthly books of $221K to $400K built on owned leads resold at a markup to buyers who stay above a 2x to 3x ROAS.
diagrams.assumptions_note: The 5-step order is an editorial sequencing of steps the practitioners describe. All dollar figures are attributed practitioner claims, not audited results.
diagrams.note: Sources - Billy Robinson (NStq42nosUk, -_uHG2CwBjA), Kelly Joseph (muQkzU3fXJY), Hunter Ceroy (0Cfp-Fc0sag), My First Million (Poc5H6aVTlw).

diagrams.title: Four Gates Before a Cold Email Campaign Launches
diagrams.subtitle: Domain isolation, warmup, list hygiene and seed testing

nodes.question: Is cold volume running only on lookalike secondary domains redirected to the main site?
nodes.fail_action: Stop. A main-email automation cost Ethan Fleming a $2,000-a-month client, and a 10,000-email blast tanked a client's main sending.

nodes.question: Are SPF, DKIM, DMARC and MX published and every inbox warmed 2 to 3 weeks?
nodes.fail_action: Keep warming. Smartlead keeps warmup running even after campaigns start.

nodes.question: Is the list 20% or less catch-all addresses?
nodes.fail_action: Trim catch-alls. MailReach sees around 23% of catch-alls bounce when sent all at once.

nodes.question: Do seed tests to Gmail and Outlook accounts you control land in the inbox?
nodes.pass_next: Launch with bounce auto-pause armed at 5%
nodes.fail_action: Do not launch harder. Stop and diagnose, per Coldbot.

diagrams.caption: Practitioners treat authentication and warmup as prerequisites, then arm a 5% bounce auto-pause so a bad list cannot burn the fleet.
diagrams.assumptions_note: Gate order is an editorial sequence of the operator gates described. Coldbot stresses that passing them guarantees nothing about inbox placement.
diagrams.note: Sources - Ethan Fleming Marketing (TB1PQrXx5s8 @ 00:08:53), Smartlead (GZEdhosrYRc @ 00:10:11 and 00:14:23), Damien - MailReach (8EaKo_iAiPE @ 00:07:24), Coldbot (fM-ywBq8yoU @ 00:05:21).

diagrams.title: One-to-One Consent Architecture for Lead Buyers
diagrams.subtitle: Who holds the record, what gets captured, and how revocations are honored

center.role: Lead Buyer Placing the Call or Text
center.headcount: One named seller per consent checkbox
center.focus: Hold the TrustedForm or Jornaya certificate before dialing. If you're a lead buyer the risk is on you (Seasalt AI).

spokes.kpi: One checkbox per brand, 20-30px boxes, CTA text matched word for word. 1-3% conversion drop for a 10-20% contact-rate lift (LeadCaptureIO).
Hidden field labeled 'XX trusted form cert' exactly. Records kept at least 4 years (LeadCaptureIO).
Audit by capacity, not clicks. Preview dial likely an ATDS outside PA, DE and NJ. Text automation ends at day 90 on inquiry leads.
Honor within 10 business days, within 24 hours if practicable. Exposure of $500 to $2,000 per text or call violation.

diagrams.caption: Each seller must be named and individually selected, and the caller holds the consent record before regulated technology touches the lead.
diagrams.assumptions_note: Practitioners disagree on status. Troutman treated the rule as live January 27, 2025, while LeadCaptureIO and Kyle Banks reported it shot down.
diagrams.note: Sources - Lead Generation World (6VtW3u8e6WE @ 00:25:30, OgyCXKzIJM4 @ 00:24:16), Seasalt AI (KBFaRW7QmVQ), LeadCaptureIO (Hd19AToxex4, WXqAR94YqtU, Zrihem0vYcU), Lauro Herrera (tRO0J70WjKA @ 00:13:21).

diagrams.title: Four-Week Roadmap to Live Lead and Call Distribution
diagrams.subtitle: Payloads, testing, buyer guardrails and billable call rules

weeks.title: Map Buyer Payloads
weeks.deliverable: Payload type (form or JSON) set before any edit, required fields confirmed with each buyer, non-required fields stripped from the ping.
weeks.gate: Payload type locked first, since switching it resets the builder (Lead Prosper).

weeks.title: Test the Ping Post Auction
weeks.deliverable: lp_test set to 1 on ping and post, with 15-second ping and 30-second post timeouts excluding lagging buyers (boberdoo.com).
weeks.gate: lp_test and lp_action test removed before go-live.

weeks.title: Set Buyer Guardrails
weeks.deliverable: Max best price ceiling on every dynamic buyer, refund cap at 15% over the past 30 days, and 'yes but sold non-exclusively' resale above cost.
weeks.gate: Refund cap in place before the first invoice goes out.

weeks.title: Route Calls and Automate Follow-Up
weeks.deliverable: Pay-per-call at $100 per call qualified by duration thresholds such as 90 seconds, plus a voice AI callback within 60 seconds and a three-step SMS sequence.
weeks.gate: No call billed below the buyer's duration qualifier, as with the 47-second call.

diagrams.caption: Capture the lead, route it in seconds to the buyer who pays most, and follow up before a competitor does.
diagrams.assumptions_note: The week-by-week cadence is an editorial ordering of steps the practitioners describe, not a schedule any of them reported.
diagrams.note: Sources - boberdoo.com (DSbDVWpyXUI @ 00:15:43 and 00:17:44, yCAVYNpSdZI @ 00:22:50), Lead Prosper (gX0fjRlg1lg, _1N3fncM-Ss), Local SEO Made Easy (Bu_9XhXpDSs), Jason Grossman (Ot93upK_YX4 @ 00:52:38).
